title: InventoryCheck
description: Status of the last logged-in inventory check for one provider: whether we can see real stock, and when we last looked.

access.description: How the provider can be reached for inventory: documented API, CLI, web console, or nothing self-serve

login.description: State of our own access: ok = we can sign in, blocked = account exists but cannot authenticate/validate, no-account = we have none

inventory.description: visible = real stock numbers per GPU; empty = catalogue/entitlements empty; not-exposed = you can order but stock is never shown; unknown = not looked

stock_recorded.description: true when the check produced availability observations in data/availability

order_path.description: What it takes to actually get a GPU after the check
